integrity: The proof uses an exact finite-sample Hoeffding decomposition of two quadratic empirical-process functionals. All diagonal and Brownian-bridge-kernel integrals are evaluated explicitly, and a standalone high-precision checker independently recomputes the six required integrals and the finite-sample identities.
scientific_limitations: The formulas assume a fully specified continuous null; parameter estimation changes the empirical-process covariance.
The result concerns covariance and correlation only, not joint tail probabilities or comparative power.
A generic weighted-Cramér–von Mises joint-moment formula may imply the specialization even though no explicit cross-statistic formula was located.
title: Cramér–von Mises and Anderson–Darling statistics have an exact finite-sample covariance
